items.te: A generalizable deep learning model for predicting opioid use disorder using language modeling for cross-EHR data harmonization
items.se: We developed OUD-REY (OUD Risk Evaluator at 1 Year) - a deep learning model that uses longitudinal electronic health record (EHR) data from the All of Us research program to predict risk of OUD at one year for patients with an opioid prescription. On internal validation, OUD-REY achieved an AUROC of 91.2% and AUPRC of 77.0%. We externally validated our model on a new dataset released by All of Us that was temporally separated from our development set and on a dataset containing ~6 million patients from medical centers of the Veterans Affairs (VA) nationwide over a span of 20 years. On external validation, our model had an AUROC and AUPRC of 86.4% and 23.1% (OUD prevalence of 2.9%), respectively, on our temporally separated All of Us validation set.

items.t: 评估大型语言模型衍生的输出作为心理测量：适用于日常压力的五领域心理测量框架
items.te: Evaluating Large Language Model–Derived Outputs as Psychological Measures: A Five-Domain Psychometric Framework With Application to Daily Stress
items.s: 结论：仅预测指标不足以评估大语言模型衍生的心理测量。以测量为导向的评估揭示了一些属性，包括水平相关效应和不对称误差归因，这些属性对基于大语言模型的评估研究如何解释其结果有直接影响。对于临床使用，该措施是对现有纵向监测筛查仪器的补充，而不是独立的诊断。结果：特征显示出高重复性（平均组内相关系数 = 0.987）、结构依赖性收敛效度（Spearman ρ = 0.08 至 0.79）以及当天压力的个人跟踪（负面情绪 β = 0.68）。
items.se: Conclusions: Prediction metrics alone are insufficient for evaluating LLM-derived psychological measures. Measurement-oriented evaluation revealed properties, including level-dependent effects and asymmetric error attribution, that have direct implications for how LLM-based assessment studies interpret their results. For clinical use, the measure is a complement to existing screening instruments for longitudinal monitoring, not a stand-alone diagnostic. Results: Features showed high repeatability (mean intraclass correlation coefficient=0.987), construct-dependent convergent validity (Spearman ρ=0.08 to 0.79), and within-person tracking of same-day stress (negative emotion β=0.68).

editorial.reason: 提供了首个面向测量学的五维度框架评估LLM派生心理测量输出，区分个体内/个体间效应、参照标签局限等预测导向评估无法揭示的问题，可直接迁移到纵向监测与数字表型研究设计。主要限制是单一样本（呼叫中心员工15天语音数据）、对照仅为LIWC，且作者自认仅作筛查补充而非诊断工具。

reviews.reason: 提供了首个针对LLM衍生心理测量输出的五域心理测量学评估框架，含3556人天的生态瞬时评估数据、跨模型复现与结构化误差归因，可直接迁移到语言数据测量研究的验证设计；局限是样本为呼叫中心员工、比较基准为词典法，泛化到临床人群仍需外部验证。

items.t: Stryker 向 CMR Surgical 投资 4 亿美元，进军软组织机器人领域
items.te: Stryker enters soft tissue robotics with $400M investment in CMR Surgical
items.s: Stryker 周一表示，已与软组织机器人公司 CMR Surgical 合作，向该公司投资约 4 亿美元，并成为 CMR 系统的美国独家经销商。总部位于英国剑桥的 CMR 去年获得了美国食品和药物管理局的批准，其最新的机器人系统可以在美国执行胆囊手术。摩根大通分析师罗比·马库斯在一份研究报告中写道，截至 2026 年初，该公司已在全球执行了超过 45,000 例手术。 Stifel 分析师 Rick Wise 在一份研究报告中写道，多年来，史赛克一直被期望进入软组织机器人市场。怀斯补充道，随着竞争对手强生公司和美敦力公司在美国的机器人获得 FDA 批准，“对于史赛克来说，现在是时候做出决定了，机不可失。”
items.se: Stryker said Monday it has partnered with soft tissue robotics firm CMR Surgical, investing about $400 million into the company and becoming the exclusive U.S. distributor of CMR’s system. Cambridge, England-based CMR received Food and Drug Administration clearance for its latest robotic system last year to perform gallbladder procedures in the U.S. As of early 2026, the company had performed more than 45,000 procedures globally, J.P. Morgan analyst Robbie Marcus wrote in a research note. Stryker had been expected to enter the soft tissue robotics market for years, Stifel analyst Rick Wise wrote in a research note. With competitors Johnson & Johnson and Medtronic receiving FDA nods for their own robots in the U.S., Wise added, “it feels like a now or never moment for Stryker to make the decision.”

editorial.reason: Stryker以4亿美元投资CMR Surgical并成为其美国独家分销商，是软组织手术机器人竞争格局的直接产业事实，产业读者可据此评估Intuitive、J&J、Medtronic之外的竞争态势与渠道布局。限制在于材料未披露交易条款细节及CMR商业化进展对回报的影响。

items.t: 口服 deucrictibant 用于按需治疗遗传性血管性水肿发作：一项 3 期、多中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照交叉试验。
items.te: Oral deucrictibant for on-demand treatment of hereditary angioedema attacks: a phase 3, multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial.
items.s: 背景 在遗传性血管性水肿（一种罕见的缓激肽介导的疾病）中，促进迅速给药并提供快速、持续缓解和缓解发作的口服按需治疗仍然很少。我们研究了 deucrictibant（一种口服缓激肽 B2 受体拮抗剂）用于按需治疗遗传性血管性水肿发作的疗效和安全性。方法 RAPIDe-3 是一项 3 期、双盲、2 × 2 交叉试验，受试者为患有遗传性血管水肿的青少年和成人参与者（年龄分别为 ≥12 岁至 < 18 岁和年龄 ≥18 至≤75 岁），在六大洲 24 个国家的 59 个地点进行。
items.se: Background In hereditary angioedema, a rare bradykinin-mediated condition, oral on-demand treatments facilitating prompt administration and providing rapid, sustained relief and attack resolution remain scant. We investigated the efficacy and safety of deucrictibant, an oral bradykinin B2 receptor antagonist, for on-demand treatment of hereditary angioedema attacks. Methods RAPIDe-3 was a phase 3, double-blind, 2 × 2 crossover trial in adolescent and adult participants (aged ≥12 to < 18 years and aged ≥18 to ≤75 years, respectively) with hereditary angioedema, at 59 sites across 24 countries on six continents.

editorial.reason: III期双盲交叉RCT报告口服缓激肽B2受体拮抗剂deucrictibant按需治疗遗传性血管性水肿发作显著缩短症状缓解时间，填补该罕见病口服按需治疗的证据空白，对罕见病临床试验设计（交叉设计、发作水平分析）亦有参考价值；但摘要数据被截断，完整终点与安全性细节需查原文，且为药企资助研究。

items.t: 烟酰胺核苷治疗早期帕金森病患者：NOPARK 随机临床试验。
items.te: Nicotinamide Riboside for Patients With Early-Stage Parkinson Disease: The NOPARK Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.s: 重要性 烟酰胺核苷是一种烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸前体，根据临床前和早期研究，已被提议作为帕金森病的潜在疾病缓解疗法。长期口服烟酰胺核苷是否可以改善帕金森病的临床结果尚不清楚。目的 确定与安慰剂相比，烟酰胺核苷是否可以改善帕金森病的临床结果。设计、设置和参与者 在挪威 11 个中心进行的随机、双盲、安慰剂对照 3 期临床试验。符合资格的参与者是年龄35岁或以上、入组前2年内诊断出患有帕金森病、Hoehn和Yahr疾病分期小于3、异常多巴胺转运蛋白闪烁扫描结果证实多巴胺能黑质纹状体去神经以及入组前接受稳定多巴胺能治疗的患者。
items.se: Importance Nicotinamide riboside, a nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide precursor, has been proposed as a potential disease-modifying therapy for Parkinson disease based on preclinical and early studies. Whether prolonged oral nicotinamide riboside improves clinical outcomes in Parkinson disease is unknown. Objective To determine whether nicotinamide riboside improves clinical outcomes in Parkinson disease compared with placebo. Design, setting, and participants Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 clinical trial conducted at 11 centers in Norway. Eligible participants were patients aged 35 years or older with Parkinson disease diagnosed within 2 years before enrollment, Hoehn and Yahr disease stage less than 3, abnormal dopamine transporter scintigraphy findings confirming dopaminergic nigrostriatal denervation, and stable dopaminergic treatment before enrollment.

editorial.reason: 高质量的III期RCT以阴性结果否定了烟酰胺核糖对早期帕金森病的疾病修饰作用，且提示非运动症状负担加重，对NAD前体类研究设计和补充剂宣称有直接校准价值；结论基于摘要级信息，全文细节与亚组分析尚未核实。

items.t: 苹果被责令向 Masimo 支付 1.84 亿美元专利损害利息
items.te: Apple ordered to pay Masimo $184M in interest on patent damages
items.s: 美国地区法院已下令苹果公司就陪审团去年裁定的损害赔偿金向 Masimo 支付 1.842 亿美元利息。该利息涵盖陪审团一年前要求苹果公司向 Masimo 支付 6.34 亿美元的赔偿金。苹果公司收到该命令是因为其 Apple Watch 产品侵犯了脉搏血氧饱和度专利。美国加利福尼亚州中区地方法院周一在利息裁决中站在 Masimo 一边，使苹果公司需要支付的总额超过 8.18 亿美元。丹纳赫 6 月份以 99 亿美元收购了 Masimo。
items.se: A U.S. district court has ordered Apple to pay Masimo $184.2 million in interest on the damages a jury awarded last year. The interest covers the $634 million in damages that a jury ordered Apple to pay Masimo one year ago. Apple received the order because its Apple Watch product infringed a pulse oximetry patent. A judge for the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California sided with Masimo in a ruling on interest Monday, bringing the total Apple needs to pay to more than $818 million. Danaher bought Masimo for $9.9 billion in June.

items.t: 怀孕前四价人乳头瘤病毒疫苗接种和妊娠结局：全国范围内基于人群的病例对照研究。
items.te: Quadrivalent human papillomavirus vaccination before pregnancy and pregnancy outcomes: nationwide, population based case-control study.
items.s: 目的 评估孕前四价人乳头瘤病毒疫苗接种与随后不良妊娠结局风险之间的关联。设计全国范围内基于人群的匹配病例对照研究。设置瑞典人口，2006年1月1日至2023年12月31日。参与者2006年至2023年间瑞典16-35岁未生育妇女中有624 713名单胎婴儿； 92 620 名（14.8%）女性在怀孕前接受了四价人乳头瘤病毒疫苗接种。
items.se: Objective To evaluate the association between quadrivalent human papillomavirus vaccination before pregnancy and subsequent risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes. Design Nationwide, population based matched case-control study. Setting Population of Sweden, from 1 January 2006 to 31 December 2023. Participants 624 713 singleton births among nulliparous women aged 16-35 years in Sweden between 2006 and 2023; 92 620 (14.8%) women had received quadrivalent human papillomavirus vaccination before pregnancy.

items.t: 覆盖范围透明度最终规则 (CMS 9882-F)
items.te: Transparency in Coverage Final Rules (CMS 9882-F)
items.s: 承保透明度最终规则 (CMS 9882-F) 简介 与 2026 年 10 月 5 日发布的第 14221 号总统行政命令“通过为患者提供清晰、准确和可操作的医疗保健定价信息，让美国再次健康”一致，卫生与公共服务部（通过医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心）与劳工部和财政部（统称为财政部）合作，各部门）联合最终确定了对保险范围透明度规定的修改，以提高参与者、受益人和参保者定价披露的可及性，以及非祖父团体健康计划和提供非祖父团体或个人健康保险承保的健康保险发行人公开定价披露的标准化和可靠性。
items.se: Transparency in Coverage Final Rules (CMS 9882-F) Introduction Consistent with the President’s Executive Order 14221 , “Making America Healthy Again by Empowering Patients with Clear, Accurate, and Actionable Healthcare Pricing Information,” on October 5, 2026, the Department of Health and Human Services (through the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services), in partnership with the Departments of Labor and the Department of the Treasury (collectively, the Departments) jointly finalized changes to the Transparency in Coverage regulations to improve the accessibility of pricing disclosures to participants, beneficiaries, and enrollees, and the standardization and reliability of the public pricing disclosures from non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers offering non-grandfathered group or individual health insurance coverage.

items.te: A Patient Simulation Framework for Risk Assessment of Conversational Health Care AI: Development and Evaluation Study

items.t: 临床预测模型的沙普利值解释：范围综述和指南
items.te: Shapley value explanations for clinical prediction models: a scoping review and guide
items.s: 沙普利值解释越来越多地用于为医疗保健领域的“黑盒”预测模型提供更高的透明度。在本文中，我们对 Shapley 值解释进行了介绍性概述，并通过对 100 篇随机选择的同行评审出版物（这些出版物使用 Shapley 解释作为其临床研究的一部分）进行详细的范围综述来描述其用途。我们重点关注使用 Shapley 值解释来解释临床预测模型的预测，该模型使用表格输入特征（例如，测量血压和年龄等患者特征的预测变量）来预测个体的健康结果。在我们对文献的回顾中，我们发现用于计算沙普利值解释的方法经常被低估。

In this article, we provide an introductory overview of Shapley value explanations and describe their use through a detailed scoping review of 100 randomly selected, peer-reviewed publications that used Shapley explanations as part of their clinical research. We focus on the use of Shapley value explanations to explain the predictions of clinical prediction models that use tabular input features (e.g., predictors that measure patient characteristics like blood pressure and age) to predict health outcomes in individuals. items.t: 通过多国临床验证和阅片者研究，可解释的多模态检索增强乳腺超声诊断
items.te: Interpretable multimodal retrieval augmented diagnosis for breast ultrasound with multinational clinical validation and reader study
items.s: 我们提出了 B-RAD，一种 BI-RADS 感知的检索增强诊断框架，它反映了放射科医生检索范例、定位病变和确定 BI-RADS 类别的工作流程。我们在来自 7 个国家的 11 个队列中验证了 B-RAD，总计 8311 张图像，涵盖内部验证和三个外部队列（包括一个独立机构队列）。整个管道在该机构队列中达到了 0.952 的活检分类 AUROC，无需微调，优于现有的视觉语言模型。在一项四位读者的研究中，B-RAD 的帮助提高了准确性，将读者间的一致性从中等提高到显着，并减少了所有读者漏诊的恶性肿瘤。
items.se: We propose B-RAD, a BI-RADS-aware retrieval-augmented diagnosis framework that mirrors the radiologist workflow of retrieving exemplars, localizing lesions, and determining the BI-RADS category. We validated B-RAD on eleven cohorts from seven countries totaling 8311 images, spanning internal validation and three external cohorts including an independent institutional cohort. The full pipeline reached a biopsy triage AUROC of 0.952 on that institutional cohort without fine-tuning, outperforming existing vision-language models. In a four-reader study, B-RAD assistance improved accuracy, raised inter-reader agreement from moderate to substantial, and reduced missed malignancies across all readers.

items.t: OncoTagger：Web of Science 中开放获取的 AI 肿瘤学文章的可重复摘要级研究图谱
items.te: OncoTagger: a reproducible abstract-level landscape of open-access AI-oncology articles in Web of Science
items.s: 我们开发了 OncoTagger，这是一种基于规则的抽象级证据监控管道，并将其应用于 Web of Science 核心合集中索引的英语开放获取文章语料库，并在 2019 年至 2025 年的标题、摘要、关键词和元数据级别进行分析。预测层加权语料库级别估计显示指标检测准确度为 92.3%（95% CI） 88.9–95.2%），敏感性为 89.3%（85.4–93.3%），特异性为 98.2%（94.5–100.0%）。它应该被解释为可重复的总体监测基础设施，而不是人工智能肿瘤学领域的全面普查、经过验证的文章级分类器或算法性能的比较评估。
items.se: We developed OncoTagger, a rule-based abstract-level evidence-surveillance pipeline, and applied it to an English-language, open-access article corpus indexed in the Web of Science Core Collection and analyzed at the title-, abstract-, keyword-, and metadata level from 2019 to 2025. Prediction-stratum-weighted corpus-level estimates showed metric-detection accuracy of 92.3% (95% CI 88.9–95.2%), sensitivity of 89.3% (85.4–93.3%), and specificity of 98.2% (94.5–100.0%). It should be interpreted as reproducible aggregate surveillance infrastructure, not as a full census of the AI-oncology field, a validated article-level classifier, or a comparative evaluation of algorithmic performance.

items.t: 身体质量指数的大脑特征可预测心脏代谢和呼吸系统疾病状态
items.te: Brain signatures of body mass index predict cardiometabolic and respiratory disease status
items.s: 尽管使用神经网络的大脑生物标志物取得了进展，但体重对大脑结构的影响却被忽视了，特别是与非传染性疾病有关的影响。我们在 T1 加权 MRI 扫描上应用深度学习来预测六个独立队列的 BMI，并实现了强大的队列内表现和较低的外部表现。
items.se: Despite advances in brain biomarkers using neural networks, the effects of body mass on brain structure have been neglected, particularly in connection with noncommunicable diseases. We applied deep learning on T1-weighted MRI scans to predict BMI from six independent cohorts and achieved strong within-cohort and reduced external performance.

items.t: 医护人员纵向应力分布的多模态计算分析
items.te: Multimodal computational analysis of longitudinal stress profiles in healthcare workers
items.s: 我们评估了对简短的、远程收集的应力叙述的多模态计算分析是否可以区分纵向应力分布。在保留的测试集中，该模型的 AUROC 为 0.75，优于单峰（语言嵌入；AUROC = 0.63）和双峰（语言 + 声学；AUROC = 0.70）配置。
items.se: We evaluated whether multimodal computational analysis of brief, remotely collected stress narratives could distinguish longitudinal stress profiles. In a held-out test set, the model achieved an AUROC of 0.75, outperforming unimodal (linguistic embeddings; AUROC = 0.63) and bimodal (linguistic + acoustic; AUROC = 0.70) configurations.

items.t: 以临床医生为中心的大型语言模型生成的长期住院出院总结的评估
items.te: Clinician-centered evaluation of large language model-generated discharge summaries for longer hospitalizations
items.s: 尽管大型语言模型 (LLM) 在生成出院摘要方面表现出了良好的前景，但其在较长住院时间中的表现仍缺乏充分研究。之前对大语言模型生成的出院摘要的评估主要涉及较短的住院时间，并且很少检查接收临床医生的优先事项或偶然发现的报告。我们比较了大语言模型生成的和人工撰写的 60 例持续 7 至 21 天的内科住院的出院摘要，并由住院医生和初级保健医生 (PCP) 进行配对评估。 95% 的临床医生审稿人更喜欢大语言模型生成的摘要，并对它们的质量、可读性、真实性和完整性给予更高的评价。 PCP 认为大语言模型生成的摘要更适合理解并向患者传达医院护理并提供后续护理。
items.se: Although large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for discharge summary generation, their performance in longer hospitalizations remains less well studied. Prior evaluations of LLM-generated discharge summaries have largely involved shorter stays and have rarely examined receiving-clinician priorities or incidental finding reporting. We compared LLM-generated and human-authored discharge summaries for 60 Internal Medicine hospitalizations lasting 7 to 21 days, with paired assessment by hospitalists and primary care physicians (PCPs). Clinician reviewers preferred LLM-generated summaries for 95% of encounters and rated them higher for quality, readability, factuality and completeness. PCPs rated LLM-generated summaries as better for understanding and communicating hospital care to patients and providing follow-up care.

items.t: 机器学习模型预测心血管肾代谢综合征的三年死亡率
items.te: Machine Learning Model Predicts Three Year Mortality in Cardiovascular Kidney Metabolic Syndrome
items.s: 我们开发并验证了机器学习模型，以预测来自 29 个医疗中心的 219,561 名 CKM 2-4 期住院患者的 3 年全因死亡率。 8 变量 XGBoost 模型始终优于 LASSO 模型，在推导、内部和基于中心的验证队列中，受试者工作特征曲线 [ROC-AUC] 分别为 0.831、0.826 和 0.813。
items.se: We developed and validated machine learning models to predict 3-year all-cause mortality in 219,561 hospitalized patients with CKM stages 2-4 from 29 medical centers. An 8-variable XGBoost model consistently outperformed the LASSO model, achieving receiver operating characteristic curve [ROC-AUC] of 0.831, 0.826, and 0.813 in the derivation, internal, and center-based validation cohorts, respectively.

items.t: 低功耗无线通信技术赋能可穿戴医疗保健监控
items.te: Low-power wireless communication technologies empower wearable healthcare monitoring
items.s: 低功耗无线通信对于长期可穿戴医疗保健监测至关重要。本综述从原理、能量机制、架构和性能方面对射频识别（RFID）、近场通信（NFC）、反向散射通信（BackCom）和超宽带（UWB）进行了结构化技术比较。我们进一步研究它们在体液和生命参数监测中的应用，确定功率、范围、集成和安全性方面的挑战，并为选择下一代可穿戴医疗系统的通信技术提供指导。
items.se: Low-power wireless communication is critical for long-term wearable healthcare monitoring. This review presents a structured technical comparison of radio frequency identification (RFID), near field communication (NFC), backscatter communication (BackCom), and ultra-wideband (UWB) in terms of principles, energy mechanisms, architectures, and performance. We further examine their applications in body-fluid and vital-parameter monitoring, identify challenges in power, range, integration and security, and provide guidance for selecting communication technologies for next-generation wearable medical systems.

items.t: 6~23月龄儿童小量脂质营养补充剂和麻疹疫苗接种覆盖率：一项实用的整群随机试验
items.te: Small quantity lipid-based nutritional supplementation and measles vaccination coverage in children aged 6−23 months: a pragmatic cluster-randomized trial
items.s: 在这项研究中，我们在尼日利亚北部进行了一项儿科、务实、整群随机对照试验，评估了在常规免疫服务的同时分发预防性小剂量脂质营养补充剂 (SQ-LNS) 是否可以增加疫苗接种率。 NutriVax 组中获得卡验证的 MCV1 的几率是对照组的两倍（优势比 = 2.08，95% 置信区间 (CI)：1.30−3.35，P = 0.004）。共同提供 SQ-LNS 与常规免疫大大提高了经卡验证的 MCV1 吸收率，支持可扩展的战略，以在类似环境中朝着世界卫生组织 2030 年免疫议程设定的目标取得进展。
items.se: In this study, we evaluated whether distributing preventive small-quantity lipid-based nutrient supplements (SQ-LNS) alongside routine immunization services may increase vaccine uptake in a pediatric, pragmatic, cluster-randomized controlled trial in northern Nigeria. The odds of receiving card-verified MCV1 were two times higher in the NutriVax arm than in the control arm (odds ratio = 2.08, 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.30−3.35, P = 0.004). Co-delivering SQ-LNS with routine immunization substantially improved card-verified MCV1 uptake, supporting a scalable strategy to make progress toward targets set by the World Health Organizationʼs Immunization Agenda 2030 in similar settings.

items.t: 尿液游离 RNA 用于膀胱癌检测和治疗反应预测
items.te: Urine cell-free RNA for bladder cancer detection and treatment response prediction
items.s: 尿液生物标志物有望改善泌尿生殖系统恶性肿瘤的无创检测和分子表征。该方法优于尿液肿瘤 DNA 分析，并且不受场效应突变的影响。
items.se: Urine biomarkers promise to improve noninvasive detection and molecular characterization of genitourinary malignancies. The method outperformed urine tumor DNA analysis and was unaffected by the presence of field-effect mutations.

items.t: 探索 YouTube 上科学和伪科学健康社区的对话动态：流程挖掘和网络分析研究
items.te: Exploring Conversational Dynamics in Scientific and Pseudoscientific Health Communities on YouTube: Process Mining and Network Analysis Study
items.s: 结论：网络分析和流程挖掘技术的应用揭示了与健康相关的 YouTube 讨论的对话动态中的不同模式。在采样的语料库中，科学讨论似乎与混合价评估和治疗相关的交流更兼容，而伪科学讨论则显示出与人际肯定和社会情感联系更一致的模式。这些初步研究结果表明，网络分析和过程挖掘是研究在线健康传播和错误信息生态系统的有前途的方法。他们还建议，公共卫生战略可能会受益于在信息提供的同时考虑参与错误信息社区的情感和社区联系维度。结果：网络分析揭示了不同的对话核心。
items.se: Conclusions: The application of network analysis and process mining techniques revealed distinct patterns in the conversational dynamics of health-related YouTube discussions. Within the sampled corpora, scientific discussions appeared more compatible with mixed-valence evaluation and treatment-related exchanges, whereas pseudoscientific discussions showed patterns more consistent with interpersonal affirmation and socioemotional bonding. These preliminary findings suggest that network analysis and process mining are promising approaches for investigating online health communication and misinformation ecosystems. They also suggest that public health strategies may benefit from considering the affective and community-bonding dimensions of engagement in misinformation communities alongside information provision. Results: Network analysis revealed divergent conversational cores.

items.t: 用于标准化临床评估交互式培训的语音虚拟患者：混合方法试点研究
items.te: Voice-Enabled Virtual Patients for Interactive Training in Standardized Clinical Assessment: Mixed Methods Pilot Study
items.s: 结论：大语言模型支持的虚拟患者模拟为培训临床医生进行标准化临床评估提供了一种有前途的、可扩展的工具。该试点研究为系统以合理的保真度生成临床相关实践场景的能力提供了初步证据。结果：在 20 次访谈中，虚拟患者表现出对其配置的临床资料的合理遵守，人类评分者的分数接近其预定义的分数配置。 MADRS 评分者评分与配置评分之间的平均项目差异为 0.52 (SD 0.75)；总分的评估者间信度为 0.90 (95% CI 0.68‐0.99)。当被要求评估虚拟患者的定性真实性和凝聚力时，专家评分者始终给出“同意”到“强烈同意”的平均评级。
items.se: Conclusions: LLM-powered virtual patient simulations offered a promising, scalable tool for training clinicians in standardized clinical assessment. This pilot study provides initial evidence for the system’s ability to produce clinically relevant practice scenarios with reasonable fidelity. Results: Across 20 interviews, the virtual patients demonstrated reasonable adherence to their configured clinical profiles, with human rater scores falling near their predefined score configurations. The mean item difference between MADRS rater scores and configured scores was 0.52 (SD 0.75); interrater reliability for the total score was 0.90 (95% CI 0.68‐0.99). Expert raters consistently gave average ratings of “agree” to “strongly agree” when asked to evaluate the qualitative realism and cohesion of the virtual patients.

items.t: 牙周炎风险评估和预防规划：多模态大语言模型和牙周病医生评估的比较研究
items.te: Periodontitis Risk Assessment and Prevention Planning: Comparative Study of Multimodal Large Language Models and Periodontist Evaluations
items.s: 结论：M-LLM 在牙周评估中表现出很强的推理能力。在所有模型中，不可接受的元素始终与射线照相解释错误相关，尽管改进的提示或更新的模型版本可能会改善这一点。值得注意的是，即使放射照相结果不正确并且不存在斑块保留因素，输出仍然评价良好，表明 EHR 数据本身就提供了坚实的基础。就临床适用性而言，M-LLM 的表现至少必须与牙周病医生相当，并满足牙周病专家制定的质量标准——GPT 和 Claude 似乎正在接近这一标准。结果：GPT o1 Pro 和 Claude Sonnet 4 显示出强劲的性能，86.7% 和 85.6% 的评级被认为可以接受，与牙周病医生的输出 (87.8%) 相当。
items.se: Conclusions: M-LLMs demonstrated strong reasoning abilities in periodontal assessment. Across all models, unacceptable elements were consistently related to errors in radiographic interpretation, though refined prompting or newer model versions may improve this. Notably, even when radiographic findings were incorrect and plaque-retentive factors were absent, outputs were still rated well, indicating that EHR data alone provide a substantial basis. For clinical applicability, M-LLMs must at least perform comparably to a periodontist and meet the quality standards set by periodontal experts—a bar that GPT and Claude appear to approach. Results: GPT o1 Pro and Claude Sonnet 4 showed strong performance, with 86.7% and 85.6% of ratings deemed acceptable—comparable to the periodontist’s output (87.8%).

items.t: 生成式人工智能操纵生物医学研究图像来改变科学结果：人类诊断研究和自动检测
items.te: Biomedical Research Images Manipulated by Generative AI to Alter Scientific Outcomes: Diagnostic Study of Human and Automated Detection
items.s: 在对 104 个蛋白质印迹和皮下异种移植肿瘤图像进行的诊断研究中，高保真生成模型产生了可能改变研究结论的伪造品； 24 名博士级专家评审员无法可靠地区分伪造数据和真实数据（平均准确度 50.5%，SD 6.9%），而性能最好的商业 AI 检测器仅实现中等辨别（曲线下面积 0.790，95% CI 0.695-0.885），揭示了当前研究诚信保障措施中的严重漏洞。
items.se: In a diagnostic study of 104 western blot and subcutaneous xenograft tumor images, a high-fidelity generative model produced forgeries that could alter the conclusions of a study; 24 PhD-level expert reviewers could not reliably distinguish the forgeries from authentic figures (mean accuracy 50.5%, SD 6.9%), while the best-performing commercial AI detector achieved only moderate discrimination (area under the curve 0.790, 95% CI 0.695-0.885), revealing critical vulnerabilities in current research-integrity safeguards.

items.t: 手术技能评估中人类自主团队的机器学习：范围综述
items.te: Machine Learning for Human-Autonomy Teaming in Surgical Skill Assessment: Scoping Review
items.s: 结论：当前的人工智能技术为客观技能评估提供了坚实的基础，但尚未为自主团队做好准备。未来的发展必须优先考虑模型的稳健性、可解释性以及与临床环境的无缝集成，以从独立的评估工具过渡到有效的手术队友。试用注册：OSF 注册中心 10.17605/OSF.IO/PQWS5；  结果：我们对 92 项纳入研究的分析揭示了向多模态数据集成和深度学习架构的主导转变。虽然基准数据集经常报告高性能，但 HAT 集成仍然存在重大障碍。 TRL 分析显示，77.2% (71/92) 的研究仍处于 TRL 3（概念验证），只有 2.2% (2/92) 达到 TRL 5 或更高。
items.se: Conclusions: Current AI techniques provide a robust foundation for objective skill assessment, but they are not yet ready for autonomous teaming. Future development must prioritize model robustness, interpretability, and seamless integration into clinical environments to transition from stand-alone assessment tools to effective surgical teammates. Trial Registration: OSF Registries 10.17605/OSF.IO/PQWS5; https://osf.io/pqws5 Results: Our analysis of the 92 included studies reveals a dominant shift toward multimodal data integration and deep learning architectures. While high performance is frequently reported on benchmark datasets, significant barriers to HAT integration persist. The TRL analysis shows that 77.2% (71/92) of studies remain at TRL 3 (proof-of-concept), with only 2.2% (2/92) reaching TRL 5 or above.
